text_block_list.text:
Today is the Japanese Derby, and<n>tens of
thousands of fans have<n>packed into the Tokyo
Racecourse for<n>this event.

They're all here to see last month's<n>top three of
the Satsuki Sho—the<n>so-called "BNW."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
From two major prospects to three,<n>Biwa
Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and<n>Winning Ticket have
entered the<n>hearts of many as fan favorites.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wow, they even gave us an acronym.<n>"BNW," huh?
choice_data_list: You've got a lot of eyes on you now.
You've got a lot of eyes on you now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, there certainly were more<n>reporters than usual
at last week's<n>public training session, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She's been turning down<n>interviews and
refusing to talk with<n>fans, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's weird. She's not acting like the<n>Tickezo we all
know and love.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: If you're worried about something, talk to me.
If you're worried about something, talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing serious. I just feel<n>nervous, like when
I'm waiting for<n>my test to be handed back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's like when you don't know the<n>right answer to
a question and you<n>can't stop thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I know my winning equation mustlead to a solution. And I intend to findthe best answer that I can in this race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (The strange feeling I had at the<n>Satsuki Sho...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (The strange feeling I've had sincethe Satsuki Sho...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Ticket! I know you can<n>become the
Derby Champion!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Got that right! Just you watch me win<n>this!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (...I'd better focus on the race right<n>now.)
